Audi Certified Pre-Owned Benefits:

1-Year / 20,000-Mile Audi CPO Limited Warranty: Coverage begins on the CPO sale date or upon expiration of the New Vehicle Limited Warranty, whichever occurs later.

$0 Deductible: The Audi Certified Pre-Owned Limited Warranty features no deductible for covered warranty repairs.

125+ Point Inspection: Every Audi Certified Pre-Owned vehicle must complete a comprehensive 125+ point inspection as part of the certification process.

Vehicle History Report: A vehicle history report is required as part of the Audi Certified Pre-Owned certification process.

24-Hour Roadside Assistance: Includes 1 year of unlimited-mileage roadside assistance with towing to the nearest authorized Audi dealership, battery jump-start, flat-tire service, lock-out service, fuel delivery service, emergency winching service, and trip interruption benefits.

3 Months of SiriusXM: Includes 3 months of SiriusXM for eligible equipped vehicles.

Transferable CPO Warranty: Audi Certified Pre-Owned coverage is transferable at no charge for qualifying private-party sales.



Key Features:

20\ Wheel Package: Striking 20\ 5-spoke-tripod design wheels with a bi-color finish give the Q3 an athletic and sophisticated stance.

Driver Assistance Package: Enhances everyday confidence and convenience with Adaptive Cruise Assist, Park Assist Plus, Top View Camera, and a heated steering wheel.

Infotainment Package: Elevates the cabin experience with a SONOS Sound System, SiriusXM, and USB Power Delivery.

Black Optic Package: Creates a more aggressive appearance with Anthracite Audi rings, black exterior trim, black mirror housings, and black roof rails contrasting beautifully with the Glacier White Metallic exterior.

Audi MMI Navigation Plus: The expansive 12.8\ MMI touch display provides intuitive access to navigation, entertainment, connectivity, and vehicle functions.

Audi Virtual Cockpit Plus: The 11.9\ digital driver display places important navigation and driving information directly in the driver's field of vision.

Panoramic Sunroof: Brings natural light into the cabin and creates an open, sophisticated atmosphere for front and rear passengers.

Leather Seating Surfaces: Complement the Black interior with Steel Gray stitching while providing a premium and refined cabin environment.

Power Heated Front Seats: Power-adjustable heated front seats with lumbar support provide personalized comfort, while driver memory adds everyday convenience.

Three-Zone Automatic Climate Control: Provides greater individual temperature control for enhanced comfort throughout the cabin.

Wireless Smartphone Integration & Charging: Audi smartphone interface and a wireless phone charging pad help keep compatible devices connected and powered without unnecessary cables.

Audi Advanced Key & Power Tailgate: Provide added convenience when accessing, operating, loading, and unloading the Q3.

Top View Camera & Park Assist Plus: Provide enhanced visibility and additional assistance when parking and maneuvering in tighter spaces.

Advanced Driver Assistance: Includes Adaptive Cruise Assist, Active Front Assist with Forward Collision Warning and Automatic Emergency Braking, Audi Side Assist, Lane Departure Warning, Rear Cross-Traffic Warning, and Traffic Sign Recognition.

LED Headlights Plus: Provide crisp illumination with high-beam assist while reinforcing the Q3's distinctive Audi presence.

Versatile Rear Seating: The 40/20/40 split-folding, sliding, and reclining rear seat provides flexible passenger and cargo configurations for everyday use.

EPA-Estimated Efficiency: Rated at 22 MPG city, 29 MPG highway, and 25 MPG combined.



Engine and Performance: Powering the Q3 S line is a responsive 2.0-liter TFSI turbocharged four-cylinder engine paired with a 7-speed S tronic dual-clutch transmission and quattro All-Wheel Drive. Producing 255 horsepower and 273 lb-ft of torque, the Q3 delivers responsive acceleration, confident traction, and composed everyday performance. Progressive steering and Audi drive select further enhance its agile and refined driving character.

This 2023 BMW X1 xDrive28i delivers the refined driving experience and practical versatility you expect from BMW, with the advanced technology and comfort features that make every journey more enjoyable.

- Universal Garage-Door Opener
- BMW Digital Key Plus with ultra-wideband technology
- Wireless Device Charging
- Auto-Dimming Interior & Exterior Mirrors
- Heated Front Seats & Steering Wheel
- Panoramic Moonroof
- Comfort Access Keyless Entry
- Apple CarPlay & Android Auto Compatibility
- Navigation with Widescreen Display
- SiriusXM with 360L
- Power Liftgate
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear
- Connected Package Pro
- 18" V Spoke Bi-Color Wheels
- Rain Sensing Wipers

The 2.0L 4-Cylinder DOHC 16V TwinPower Turbo engine paired with 7-Speed Automatic AWD transmission provides responsive performance and confident handling in all conditions. With an estimated 25 MPG city and 34 MPG highway, this X1 balances capability with efficiency for your daily commute and weekend adventures.

The interior reflects the thoughtful German engineering BMW is known for. Heated front seats and a heated steering wheel ensure comfort during cold months. Comfort Access Keyless Entry allows you to lock, unlock, and start your vehicle without removing your phone from your pocket or bag. The auto-dimming rearview mirror and power driver seat with memory settings adapt to your preferences, while the panoramic moonroof floods the cabin with natural light.

Technology seamlessly integrates into your driving experience. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Compatibility keep you connected, while the navigation system with widescreen display guides you efficiently. SiriusXM with 360L satellite radio provides entertainment options, and wireless device charging keeps your phone powered throughout the day.

Safety and convenience work together throughout this vehicle. Electronic Stability Control, a comprehensive airbag system, and four-wheel independent suspension work to protect and stabilize. The exterior parking camera rear assists with maneuvering, while rain-sensing wipers automatically adjust to weather conditions. Power windows, speed-sensing steering, and steering wheel-mounted audio controls make operation intuitive and effortless.

The Mineral White Metallic exterior with 18" V Spoke Bi-Color wheels delivers striking curb appeal. This X1 offers the sophistication, technology, and reliability that BMW owners have come to expect, wrapped in a practical package that meets your everyday needs.

We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience this 2023 BMW X1 xDrive28i for yourself.

description:
Thank you for choosing Audi North Orlando, this Glacier White Metallic 2023 Audi Q8 Premium is a great choice! Check out the following: No Accidents! One Owner! Convenience Package ($1,950 value)
  • Audi Phone Box with Wireless Charging
  • Audi Adaptive Cruise Assist with Lane Guidance
  • Heated Steering Wheel
  • Top View Camera System
GLACIER WHITE METALLIC, BLACK, LEATHER SEATING SURFACES This Q8 has the following features: Convenience
  • GPS linked cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until GPS linked cruise control set the pace. Simply set the desired speed and the system uses GPS navigation data to maintain that speed without driver intervention - including slowing down for curves and anticipating hills. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Meet your ultimate co-pilot, GPS linked cruise control.
Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
Technology and Telematics
  • Audi smartphone interface w/wireless Apple CarPlay & Android Auto smart device wireless mirroring
To be sure you don't miss out, give us a call at (888) 685-1813 and schedule a test drive. We are located at 139 N Oregon Street Sanford FL 32771. We look forward to seeing you soon.

The premium leather bucket seats in the front offer heating and ventilation to keep you comfortable throughout the year, while rear heated seats ensure passengers stay cozy on longer journeys.

The Durango's 3.6L V6 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission provides responsive power suited to both highway cruising and everyday driving. The all-wheel drive system enhances traction and confidence in varying road conditions. With 18 city mpg and 25 highway mpg, this SUV balances capability with reasonable fuel economy for a three-row vehicle of this size.

Inside, the Uconnect 5 navigation system with its 10.1-inch display puts control at your fingertips, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keep you seamlessly connected to your devices. The premium 19-speaker HARMAN/KARDON audio system with subwoofer transforms your daily drive into an immersive listening experience. SiriusXM with 360L provides satellite radio access, and the available SiriusXM Guardian emergency communication system adds peace of mind during travel.

The Citadel trim reflects careful attention to detail, featuring an Anodized Platinum Appearance Package that enhances the Black exterior. The 20-inch Satin Carbon aluminum wheels make a strong visual statement, while the power moonroof floods the cabin with natural light. Modern conveniences like the heated steering wheel, auto-dimming mirrors, and power liftgate contribute to an elevated ownership experience.

Safety and visibility are priorities on this Durango. The ParkView rear back-up camera provides clear guidance when reversing, while multiple airbags, electronic stability control, and traction control work together to protect occupants. Rain-sensing wipers and auto high-beam headlights adapt to changing conditions automatically, enhancing safety without requiring constant adjustment.

This Durango Citadel represents three-row SUV capability with genuine comfort and thoughtful technology. This 2023 Ford Mustang Mach-E GT combines striking blue exterior styling with modern electric performance. The GT model delivers responsive all-wheel drive capability powered by a single-speed automatic transmission, achieving an impressive 90 MPGe in city driving and 77 MPGe on the highway. With 34,283 miles, this vehicle offers excellent fuel efficiency for daily commuting and longer road trips.

The interior prioritizes driver comfort and convenience. Heated ActiveX sport seats keep you warm during cold weather, while the heated steering wheel adds another layer of comfort. The power driver seat with memory function allows you to save your preferred driving position, and the power passenger seat ensures all occupants enjoy adjustable seating. Dual front zone automatic temperature control maintains your ideal cabin climate regardless of outside conditions.

Advanced technology defines the driving experience. SYNC 4A with enhanced voice recognition provides intuitive control over vehicle functions. The connected navigation system guides you efficiently to your destination, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto seamlessly integrate your smartphone. SiriusXM Radio with 360L keeps you entertained with satellite radio programming throughout your journey.

Practical features enhance everyday usability. The power liftgate opens automatically for convenient cargo access, complemented by a cargo floor liner that protects your trunk space. The interior protection package includes first and second row floor liners, safeguarding your vehicle's interior from dirt and moisture. Rain-sensing wipers automatically adjust to changing weather conditions, and the auto-dimming rear-view mirror reduces glare during nighttime driving.

Safety and security receive careful attention. The vehicle includes four-wheel disc ABS brakes, electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel independent suspension that work together to maintain confident handling. Multiple airbags, including front dual stage, front side impact, knee, and overhead airbags, provide comprehensive protection. A security system, panic alarm, exterior parking camera, and emergency communication system with 911 Assist round out the safety suite.

The 20-inch machined-face aluminum wheels deliver a premium appearance while the body-color bumpers and spoiler enhance the vehicle's aerodynamic profile. This Mustang Mach-E GT represents modern electric vehicle technology with the styling and performance capability you expect from the Mustang name. Contact us today to schedule your test drive and discover how this vehicle can meet your transportation needs.

When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
